decisions.reason: The navigation and observation camera sits close to the firm's core heritage, has its own web page as a visible public commitment, and long space sales cycles let any weak early results be read as temporary, so the firm will persist.

The modular navigation camera embodies the announced move toward compact, flexible sensors for smaller satellites, carries heavy qualification investment, and is publicly showcased, which makes dropping it very unlikely.

The space situational awareness suite is a strategic extension aligned with the firm's direction and likely tied to agency or EU projects, so slow uptake will be attributed to an emerging market rather than failure.
The miniaturized LiDAR has a less visible public commitment (only mentioned on the website), but it fits the docking and miniaturization strategy and its sunk development costs favor persistence.
